title: A/R Detail: opening an invoice link in a new tab asks there
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an open work order invoice {Invoice-A} made at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-09 New Tab.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Customer-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Right-click {Invoice-A}'s number.
  2. Choose "Open link in new tab".
  3. Switch to the new tab.
  4. Switch back to the report's tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the browser's menu for the link opens.
  • Step 2: a new tab opens; the report's tab shows no dialog.
  • Step 3: the document page shows and asks to switch location itself.
  • Step 4: the report is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R8: “Opening a link in a new tab opens the document page, which asks to switch location itself.”
